visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a middle-aged man with short black hair wearing a white T-shirt and a black lanyard around his neck. He enthusiastically bites into a large green lettuce wrap filled with grilled meat and seasoned paste. The setting is a dimly lit restaurant featuring brick walls and warm, orange-toned industrial lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a high-angle shot of a menu displaying professional photos of raw marbled beef cuts with prices listed in Philippine Pesos. It transitions to an exterior shot of the 'YUKGA' restaurant, a modern building with large glass facades and several grey metal chairs arranged outside for waiting customers. (3) The man walks through the interior of the restaurant, which has polished wooden floors and black leather booths. Other diners are visible at tables in the background. A server wearing a bright red shirt is seen moving between tables. The camera follows the man's movement through the dining hall. (4) Multiple close-up shots show raw strips of pork belly and marinated beef slices on wooden boards. A hand uses silver tongs to place the meat onto a circular metal charcoal grill. Grey smoke rises as the meat cooks. Several small stainless steel bowls containing kimchi, garlic, and sauces are arranged nearby. (5) The man appears in a close-up again, holding a piece of cooked beef with metal chopsticks. He brings it close to his eye for inspection before eating it with an exaggerated expression of enjoyment. Bright yellow variety-style captions with black outlines appear frequently at the bottom of the frame to emphasize his speech. (6) The scene shifts to an outdoor night setting in front of a modern glass high-rise building. The man stands next to a younger male with black hair wearing black headphones. They both gesture towards the camera while talking. The area is lit by bright artificial street lamps and ambient light from the building windows. (7) The final phase shows a static end screen on a black background. A white rectangular graphic in the center contains the 'FeiFan' corporate logo in red and blue. Smaller white text below specifies the credits for sponsorship and photography while the screen fades to black.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy male narrator speaking Mandarin with high arousal and a bright, friendly tone. An upbeat acoustic pop BGM with a strong percussive beat and bright guitar strumming starts immediately, filling the spectral range. (2) As the narrator describes the restaurant, a brief digital 'pop' sound effect marks a visual transition. The acoustic environment includes a low-level indoor room tone with distant metallic clinks from dishes, while the narrator maintains a fast, enthusiastic speech rate. (3) During the food sequence, short 'whoosh' sound effects are synchronized with fast visual cuts. The BGM remains dominant but ducked under the clear narration. Perceptible chewing and crunching sounds are occasionally audible as the speaker eats. (4) The narrator’s tone becomes comedic as he makes a joke about 'chives' and 'Tesla,' with increased pitch variability and playful inflections. The BGM tempo remains steady, driving the rhythmic pace of the audio track. (5) The recording transitions to an outdoor environment where a noticeable urban noise floor with distant traffic hum and wind gusts appears. A second, younger male voice is introduced, speaking with a moderate conversational pitch and calm tone. (6) Both male voices interact in a dialogue, with the primary narrator's voice exhibiting high intensity during the price reveal. The background urban hum remains constant behind their speech. (7) The video concludes with the primary narrator delivering a final, energetic call to action. A short musical stinger SFX plays over the end screen logo, and all audio fades out quickly into silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Experience -> Product Review -> Pricing -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy travel and food vlog recommending a Korean BBQ restaurant named YUKGA in Cebu, Philippines. It highlights the quality of meat, the convenience of professional grilling services, and the cost-effectiveness of the meal to attract tourists.
